<script>

    window.HawkSearchRecs = (function () {
    var testmode = function () { return false; };
    var enabled = function () { return HawkSearch != undefined; };
    var HawkSearchRecs = {
        RegisterItemDetailsPage: function (sku) {
            if (!enabled) return;
            HawkSearch.customEvent = function () {
                HawkSearch.Context.add('uniqueid', sku);
                HawkSearch.Tracking.track('pageload', 'item');
            }
            if (testmode()) alert('HawkSearchRecs.RegisterItemDetailsPage');
        },

        RegisterLandingPage: function () {
            if (!enabled) return;
            HawkSearch.customEvent = function () {
                HawkSearch.Tracking.track('pageload', 'landing');
                if (testmode()) alert('HawkSearchRecs.RegisterLandingPage');
            }
        },

        RegisterShoppingCartPage: function (itemIds) {
            if (!enabled) return;
            HawkSearch.customEvent = function () {
                HawkSearch.Context.add('uniqueidlist', itemIds);
                HawkSearch.Tracking.track('pageload', 'cart');
            }
            if (testmode()) alert('HawkSearchRecs.RegisterShoppingCartPage');
        },

        RegisterOrderConfirmationPage: function (orderNo, idsList, itemList, total, subTotal, tax) {
            if (!enabled) return;
            HawkSearch.customEvent = function () {
                HawkSearch.Context.add('uniqueidlist', idsList);
                HawkSearch.Tracking.track('pageload', 'order');
                HawkSearch.Tracking.track('sale', { orderNo: orderNo, itemList: itemList, total: total, subtotal: subTotal, tax: tax, currency: 'USD' });
            }
            if (testmode()) alert('HawkSearchRecs.RegisterOrderConfirmationPage');
        },

        RegisterOtherPage: function () {
            if (!enabled) return;
            HawkSearch.customEvent = function () {
                HawkSearch.Tracking.track('pageload', 'custom');
            }
            if (testmode()) alert('HawkSearchRecs.RegisterOtherPage');
        },

        RegisterAddToCart: function (uniqueId, price, quantity) {
            if (!enabled) return;
            HawkSearch.customEvent = function () {
                HawkSearch.Tracking.track('add2cart', { uniqueId: uniqueId, price: price, quantity: quantity, currency: 'USD' });
            }
            if (testmode()) alert('HawkSearchRecs.RegisterAddToCart');
        },

        RegisterRateProduct: function (uniqueId, value) {
            if (!enabled) return;
            HawkSearch.customEvent = function () {
                HawkSearch.Tracking.track('rate', { uniqueId: uniqueId, value: value });
            }
            if (testmode()) alert('HawkSearchRecs.RegisterRateProduct');
        },

        RegisterSearch: function () {
            if (!enabled) return;
            HawkSearch.customEvent = function () {
                HawkSearch.Tracking.track('search');
            }
            if (testmode()) alert('HawkSearchRecs.RegisterSearch');
        }
    };

    return HawkSearchRecs;
}());
    </script>
